messages.text: For a Wireless Communication use case involving Wi-Fi 7/8, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

### Short answer
For Wi‑Fi 7/8 wireless communication testing, the signaling tester fits mainly in R&D / validation workflows where the DUT must operate in signaling mode under realistic RF, MIMO, MLO, coexistence, E2E, OTA, or interworking conditions, while the non-signaling tester fits mainly in production RF test workflows where RF measurements are run in non-signaling mode to save time.[1][2][19][44][60]
### Workflow fit
| Workflow stage | Tester type | Example in passages | Fit in the workflow |
|---|---|---|---|
| R&D design verification for Wi‑Fi 7 | Signaling tester | R&S CMX500 | The CMX500 is described as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality, used by R&D engineers in a single-instrument setup for cellular and non-cellular standards.[1][4] |
| R&D RF TX/RX characterization under realistic operation | Signaling tester | R&S CMX500 | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing requires signaling mode and real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics, with support for MLO-related multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E capabilities.[1][4] |
| OTA / realistic multipath validation for Wi‑Fi 7 devices | Signaling tester | R&S CMX500 with Bluetest / EMITE OTA environments | Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing is described as over-the-air, signaling-mode testing of IEEE 802.11be stations and access points under realistic multipath RF conditions, with R&S CMX500 integrated into Bluetest or EMITE OTA workflows.[44][60][81][92] |
| Cellular/WLAN interworking and application-layer validation | Signaling tester | R&S CMX500 | The CMX500 is used for cellular 5G and WLAN traffic offloading / interworking, including WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN using an integrated N3IWF gateway and POLQA voice quality measurement.[4][21] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 early / prototype signaling validation | Signaling tester | R&S CMX500 | The Wi‑Fi 8 page states that R&S CMX500 has newly added Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn testing capabilities and is used to validate a Broadcom prototype Wi‑Fi 8 device in RF signaling tests.[18][99] |
| Production RF test for Wi‑Fi 7 WLAN devices | Non-signaling tester | R&S CMP180 | In WLAN device production, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and the R&S CMP180 is positioned as optimized for this purpose.[2][4] |
| Production / scalable MIMO RF testing | Non-signaling tester | R&S CMP180 | The CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 units can be combined for four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access point testing.[2][4] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 candidate waveform / future-looking RF verification | Non-signaling tester | R&S CMP180 | The CMP180 is described as supporting bandwidths up to 500 MHz and demonstrating loopback verification of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform that is only a potential candidate for the yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn standard, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification.[2][16][38] |
### Practical placement
Signaling testing should be placed before production, in R&D, feature validation, OTA validation, and interworking validation, because the cited Wi‑Fi 7/8 CMX500 use cases depend on DUT operation in signaling mode and on realistic behavior such as MLO, MIMO, coexistence, E2E, WLAN offload, or prototype Wi‑Fi 8 signaling.[1][4][18][21][44][60]
Non-signaling testing should be placed in the production RF test step, because the cited WLAN production workflow performs RF measurements in non-signaling mode to save time and positions CMP180 for that role.[2][4][19]
For Wi‑Fi 8, CMX500 fits the RF signaling / prototype validation side, while CMP180 fits waveform loopback / non-signaling RF verification for a 480 MHz candidate waveform, with the caveat that the passages do not support treating 480 MHz as an official Wi‑Fi 8 standard bandwidth.[18][38][40]

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。
- 來源稱 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Wi-Fi 8 › CES 2026 外部待讀連結
[[WiFi8]]（raw converted 2026-09-17）是 OneNote link hub，列出與 [[CES 2026]]、[[Broadcom]]、[[ASUS]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[Filogic 8000]] 與 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 相關的外部文章連結。該來源只提供連結標題與 URL，未擷取正文，因此目前只能支撐 [[Wi-Fi 8 外部資料清單]]，不能作為標準內容、晶片規格、路由器展示或量產時程的證據。

可追溯的連結線索包括：

- Tom's Hardware 標題提到 [[Broadcom]] two dual-band [[Wi-Fi 8]] chips。
- TechNews / The Verge 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] router / CES before most users have switched to [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- RCR Wireless 標題提到 [[MediaTek]] previews [[Filogic 8000]] at [[CES 2026]]。
- EDN 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] silicon 與 AI touch。
- Network World 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] prioritizes reliability over speed gains。

以上均為待讀線索，不新增本頁的技術規格主張。

Wi-Fi 8 › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMP180 的關係
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 已加入 newly added [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] testing capabilities，並將在 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 驗證 [[Broadcom]] prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。

[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則在較早 MWC 2024 語境中，把 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform loopback demonstration 描述為 potential [[Wi-Fi 8]] candidate，並將 [[R&S CMP180]] 定位為 future-proof R&D / production tester。

這兩種說法層次不同：[[R&S CMX500]] 來源是 Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests / prototype device demonstration；[[R&S CMP180]] 來源是 480 MHz waveform loopback / candidate demonstration。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8
[[Wi-Fi 8]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中對 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment 的市場 / 技術稱呼；該來源描述其重點從提高 throughput 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）connectivity performance。較早的 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則把 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 稱為 yet-to-be-defined，並提到 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform potential candidate。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]（MWC 2024；發布日期來源未標示）說 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 尚未定義，且 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，並稱 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform 是 potential waveform candidate，但既有頁面 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 說依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] Wi‑Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth。判斷：前者是較早期 discussion / candidate，後者是較晚 PR 的 implemented signaling-test description；先並列，不把 480 MHz 寫成 Wi‑Fi 8 正式規格。

- [[WiFi8]] 是 OneNote link hub，不是文章正文、datasheet、configuration guide、IEEE standard text 或 certification document。
- PR / demonstration statement 不等同於 IEEE standard text、datasheet、configuration guide 或 certification document。
- 來源未標示 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] draft version、standard version、final ratification date 或 IEEE document number。
- 來源未列出完整 [[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY / MAC feature set、band plan、regulatory conditions、test requirements 或 interoperability criteria。

- 320 MHz channel bandwidth 僅能記為較晚 R&S / Broadcom PR 對 retained core PHY parameter 的說法，不可替代 IEEE 802.11bn 正式文件。
- 不可從 [[WiFi8]] 的連結標題推論 [[Broadcom]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[ASUS]] 或 [[Filogic 8000]] 的產品規格、上市時間、供應關係或認證狀態。

| 項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

- [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）：在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each [[MIMO]] link 使用 different modulation scheme；UEQM analysis 可評估 device 是否依 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。

R&S CMX500 OBT › Bluetest RTS / OTA test 語境
依 [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]：

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 可與 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）及 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 搭配。
- 支援使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 Bluetest RTS 中執行 [[5G NR Standalone]]、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）與 [[LTE]] testing。
- [[Bluetest]] 也將較早的 [[WLAN]] stations / access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）integrated testing capabilities 擴充到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 320 MHz bandwidth support。
- 來源將此整合定位為 single tester and reverberation test system 的 multi-technology validation path。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

無線通訊認證實驗室 › 重點摘要
本來源是由 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 轉出的 company restricted 簡報，正式發布日期與文件版次未標示；raw frontmatter 顯示 converted 日期為 2026-09-17。

來源將[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]定義為測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準的實驗室，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規與一致性認證，並稱其可支援 [[Global Market Access]]（GMA）與加速上市。

主要內容包括：

- 無線設備認證實驗室涵蓋 RF、EMC、安規與一致性認證。
- 主要測試項目包含頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試與 [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 來源稱認證必要性包括防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端與 6G 等需求。
- 來源列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：準備文件 / 樣品 / 電路圖 / 天線規格、提交 [[RCB]] 核驗機構初審、[[TAF]] 認可實驗室 RF / EMC 測試約 3–4 週、報告審查與證書核發，並稱證書有效期 5 年。
- 來源列出台灣領先認證實驗室：[[耕興]]、[[SGS]]、[[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]]。
- 來源稱[[耕興]]具 30 MHz–325 GHz 全頻段測試能力、108 座測試場地、連續 10 年 FCC 最佳實驗室認證、10 米半電波暗室、OTA / SAR / [[相控陣列天線]]測試等能力。
- 來源簡述 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]、[[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、Wi‑Fi / BLE 聯盟流程的差異。
- 來源將 LEO 衛星終端認證應用連到 Starlink / Kuiper user terminal RF validation、[[相控陣列天線]] beamforming 測試、mmWave / MIMO 高頻測試、台灣供應鏈 GMA，以及耕興等 [[RCB]] 提供 8–12 週 GMA 週期的說法。

Bluetest › 與 Rohde & Schwarz / R&S CMX500 的合作
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 說明，[[Bluetest]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 整合進 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software，使 [[WLAN]] developers 可使用 [[Bluetest]] reverberation chamber technology 開發 advanced WLAN stations 與 access points。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步說明，[[Bluetest]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 4G 與 [[5G NR]] test functionality 整合進 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，並將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 擴充為支援 320 MHz bandwidth。此來源將整合後的能力描述為可在 [[Bluetest]] RTS 中使用單一 tester 與 reverberation test system 驗證 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance。

來源中的 [[Kjell Olovsson]] 引言稱，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box tester 整合到 [[Bluetest Flow]] broadens Bluetest 的 WLAN testing capabilities，並可為 latest Wi-Fi 7 devices 提供 testing environment。

來源中的 [[Karl-Johan Holm]] 引言稱，[[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[Bluetest Flow]] 讓 developers 可在 Bluetest reverberation chambers 中從 WiFi 到 LTE 與 5G SA/NSA 驗證 radio and antenna performance，且此 path 是 end-to-end、fast、repeatable。

⚠️ [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）說 Bluetest CEO 是 [[Karl-Johan Holm]]，但既有頁面 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 說 Bluetest CEO 是 [[Kjell Olovsson]]。兩份來源皆未標示新聞稿發布日期且 raw created 同為 2026-09-11，無法判斷哪一個較新；並列保留，不推論職務變動。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 是在 over-the-air、signaling mode 與 realistic multipath RF conditions 下，對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 的 antenna、RF transmitter / receiver 與 multi-antenna performance 進行壓力測試的測試情境。新匯入的 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 補充另一個 partner integration 視角：[[EMITE]] OTA chambers 可整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力，用於 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] device performance assessment。

- Frequency resolution：0.01 Hz。
- Recommended calibration interval：1 year。
- Operating temperature range：+5 °C to +50 °C。
- Permissible temperature range：0 °C to +55 °C。
- Storage temperature range：–40 °C to +70 °C。
- Display：30.7 cm WXGA color touchscreen，1280 × 800 pixel。
- Internal data storage：standard solid state disk ≥ 128 Gbyte。
- AC input voltage range：100 V to 240 V；AC supply frequency：50 Hz to 60 Hz / 400 Hz。

[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]（來源標示 111年08月）列出：

- NCC 電信事業申請衛星固定通信用無線電頻率核配有關事項草案：釋出同步及非同步衛星固定通信用無線電頻率，以供電信事業新設置衛星通信網路或衛星系統者進行相關申請。

[[EMITE]] 是位於西班牙的 OTA Test Systems 公司；[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 稱其與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 合作，將 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力整合到 EMITE over-the-air chambers，以支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] OTA measurements。

[[Bluetest]] 是位於 Gothenburg, Sweden 的 wireless equipment 與 small antenna OTA testing 公司；[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 稱其為使用 Reverberation Test System 的 OTA testing pioneer and market leader。

answer.text:
### Short answer
For Wi‑Fi 7/8 wireless communication testing, the signaling tester fits mainly in R&D / validation workflows where the DUT must operate in signaling mode under realistic RF, MIMO, MLO, coexistence, E2E, OTA, or interworking conditions, while the non-signaling tester fits mainly in production RF test workflows where RF measurements are run in non-signaling mode to save time.[1][2][19][44][60]
### Workflow fit
| Workflow stage | Tester type | Example in passages | Fit in the workflow |
|---|---|---|---|
| R&D design verification for Wi‑Fi 7 | Signaling tester | R&S CMX500 | The CMX500 is described as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality, used by R&D engineers in a single-instrument setup for cellular and non-cellular standards.[1][4] |
| R&D RF TX/RX characterization under realistic operation | Signaling tester | R&S CMX500 | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing requires signaling mode and real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics, with support for MLO-related multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E capabilities.[1][4] |
| OTA / realistic multipath validation for Wi‑Fi 7 devices | Signaling tester | R&S CMX500 with Bluetest / EMITE OTA environments | Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing is described as over-the-air, signaling-mode testing of IEEE 802.11be stations and access points under realistic multipath RF conditions, with R&S CMX500 integrated into Bluetest or EMITE OTA workflows.[44][60][81][92] |
| Cellular/WLAN interworking and application-layer validation | Signaling tester | R&S CMX500 | The CMX500 is used for cellular 5G and WLAN traffic offloading / interworking, including WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN using an integrated N3IWF gateway and POLQA voice quality measurement.[4][21] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 early / prototype signaling validation | Signaling tester | R&S CMX500 | The Wi‑Fi 8 page states that R&S CMX500 has newly added Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn testing capabilities and is used to validate a Broadcom prototype Wi‑Fi 8 device in RF signaling tests.[18][99] |
| Production RF test for Wi‑Fi 7 WLAN devices | Non-signaling tester | R&S CMP180 | In WLAN device production, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and the R&S CMP180 is positioned as optimized for this purpose.[2][4] |
| Production / scalable MIMO RF testing | Non-signaling tester | R&S CMP180 | The CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 units can be combined for four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access point testing.[2][4] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 candidate waveform / future-looking RF verification | Non-signaling tester | R&S CMP180 | The CMP180 is described as supporting bandwidths up to 500 MHz and demonstrating loopback verification of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform that is only a potential candidate for the yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn standard, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification.[2][16][38] |
### Practical placement
Signaling testing should be placed before production, in R&D, feature validation, OTA validation, and interworking validation, because the cited Wi‑Fi 7/8 CMX500 use cases depend on DUT operation in signaling mode and on realistic behavior such as MLO, MIMO, coexistence, E2E, WLAN offload, or prototype Wi‑Fi 8 signaling.[1][4][18][21][44][60]
Non-signaling testing should be placed in the production RF test step, because the cited WLAN production workflow performs RF measurements in non-signaling mode to save time and positions CMP180 for that role.[2][4][19]
For Wi‑Fi 8, CMX500 fits the RF signaling / prototype validation side, while CMP180 fits waveform loopback / non-signaling RF verification for a 480 MHz candidate waveform, with the caveat that the passages do not support treating 480 MHz as an official Wi‑Fi 8 standard bandwidth.[18][38][40]

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。
- 來源稱 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Wi-Fi 8 › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMP180 的關係
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 已加入 newly added [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] testing capabilities，並將在 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 驗證 [[Broadcom]] prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。

[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則在較早 MWC 2024 語境中，把 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform loopback demonstration 描述為 potential [[Wi-Fi 8]] candidate，並將 [[R&S CMP180]] 定位為 future-proof R&D / production tester。

這兩種說法層次不同：[[R&S CMX500]] 來源是 Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests / prototype device demonstration；[[R&S CMP180]] 來源是 480 MHz waveform loopback / candidate demonstration。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8 › 使用限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]、[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 與 [[WiFi8]] 支撐。
- [[WiFi8]] 是 OneNote link hub，不是文章正文、datasheet、configuration guide、IEEE standard text 或 certification document。
- PR / demonstration statement 不等同於 IEEE standard text、datasheet、configuration guide 或 certification document。
- 來源未標示 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] draft version、standard version、final ratification date 或 IEEE document number。
- 來源未列出完整 [[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY / MAC feature set、band plan、regulatory conditions、test requirements 或 interoperability criteria。
- 480 MHz waveform 僅能記為 MWC 2024 PR 中的 potential candidate，不可寫成 Wi-Fi 8 正式規格。
- 320 MHz channel bandwidth 僅能記為較晚 R&S / Broadcom PR 對 retained core PHY parameter 的說法，不可替代 IEEE 802.11bn 正式文件。
- 不可從 [[WiFi8]] 的連結標題推論 [[Broadcom]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[ASUS]] 或 [[Filogic 8000]] 的產品規格、上市時間、供應關係或認證狀態。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 是在 over-the-air、signaling mode 與 realistic multipath RF conditions 下，對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 的 antenna、RF transmitter / receiver 與 multi-antenna performance 進行壓力測試的測試情境。新匯入的 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 補充另一個 partner integration 視角：[[EMITE]] OTA chambers 可整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力，用於 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] device performance assessment。

Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 官網新聞稿，說明 [[Bluetest]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 測試功能整合到 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software，使 WLAN 開發者與製造商可使用 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 進行 OTA MIMO stress testing。來源未標示發布日期；raw frontmatter 的 created 為 2026-09-11。
